title.narrative: Preparatory Devolution and Decentralisation Project PDDP

description.narrative: Government of Zimbabwe (GoZ) is advancing the institutionalization and operationalization of a unitary devolution system enshrined in Chapter 14 of the Constitution of Zimbabwe Amendment (No. 20) Act, 2013. The objective of this Project is to support the Government in laying a firm foundation for the execution of a comprehensive Devolution and Decentralisation programme that will result in a responsive and accountable governance system, improved service delivery, inclusive, balanced and sustainable territorial development in Zimbabwe. Premised on the recent Zimbabwe National Development Strategy 2 (NDS2) 2026-2030 and National Vision 2030, the Project’s intent seeks to leverage the implementation momentum of the devolution and decentralisation programme by supporting the a) policy, legal and institutional framework development, b) promoting the thought leadership and evidence generation and c) catalytic service delivery actions. Based on these three priority areas, the Project will then support the development of a comprehensive devolution portfolio/ programming framework to advance execution of the devolution agenda in Zimbabwe.Using the sensemaking, system thinking and portfolio approach, it will explore practical pathways for building consensus and strengthening coordination across central and local government structures, catalytically enhancing territorial capacities for policy and legal framing, planning and budgeting, execution and tracking the implementation of the devolution agenda in the country. It will also mainstream gender equality and women’s empowerment across all intervention areas.
